ticketKey.description: The Jira issue key, e.g. SSPLAN-656

jiraBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the Jira instance, e.g. https://jira.digital.ingka.com/

jiraUserEmail.description: User email for display/logging. Will be sanitized automatically (e.g. '#' replaced with '@').

jiraApiToken.description: Personal Access Token used in Bearer auth header.
